DECLARE @endDate_process DATE;

DECLARE @ytd_startDate_process DATE;
SET @ytd_startDate_process = @ytd_startDate;

DROP TABLE D360.DEPO_YTD_ALLDATES;

CREATE TABLE D360.DEPO_YTD_ALLDATES
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
	SELECT FULLDATE
		, Previous_Business_Day
		, Business_Day_Flag
		, DAYOFYEAR
		, LastDayOfMonth
		, Day
--		, case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end month_end_diff
		, DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) month_end_diff
		, YEAR
		, MONTH
		, CUST_ID
		, GAM_ACID
		, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
		, GAM_BANK_ID
		, GAM_SCHM_TYPE
		, MONTH_END
	FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
	JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
		ON 1 = 1
		AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
		AND GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND (AS_OF_DATE = @endDate_process OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' and  AS_OF_DATE < @endDate_process))
	WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN @ytd_startDate_process AND @endDate_process;

DROP TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT;

CREATE TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT
      TMP.FULLDATE
    , TMP.Previous_Business_Day
	, TMP.Business_Day_Flag --New added fields 3/28 Tommy
    , TMP.CUST_ID
    , TMP.GAM_ACID
    , TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
    , TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
--    , COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
--    , COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
	--, COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)	AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
	
	,(CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)<>YEAR(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) AND CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS='C' THEN 0 WHEN CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS='C' THEN CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL ELSE  COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) END)	AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
	
    , CAST(DAYOFYEAR AS SMALLINT) DAYOFYEAR
    , LastDayOfMonth
    , CAST(Day AS SMALLINT) Day
	, month_end_diff
    , (
--		CASE 
--			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN 
				(
					SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END)
						OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) 
					+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) else 0 end
				) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
--			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
--		END
	) AS YTD_BALANCE
	
    , (
--		CASE 
--			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN
				(
					SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END)
						OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
					+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) else 0 end
				) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
--			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
--		END
	) AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
	
    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0)) 
	/ (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
	) AS MTD_BALANCE
	
    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) else 0 end) 
	/ (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
	) AS MTD_BALANCE_PHP	

    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end *  COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0)) 
	) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE

    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) else 0 end) 
	) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	
	
    , TMP.MONTH_END
	, CURRENT_BD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
FROM D360.DEPO_YTD_ALLDATES TMP
LEFT JOIN D360.DEPO_BALANCE_ONLY CURRENT_BD
    ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
    AND TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
	
LEFT JOIN D360.DEPO_BALANCE_ONLY CURRENT_PBD
    ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID 
    AND TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
	
LEFT JOIN D360.DEP_BUSC_ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_YTD DEP_YTD
	ON TMP.GAM_ACID = DEP_YTD.ACID
	AND TMP.GAM_BANK_ID = DEP_YTD.BANK_ID
	AND TMP.FULLDATE = DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE;
